mapper.select: SELECT homepage_id, password_yn, reservation_time, loan_time, loan_time_choice, terms FROM WALKING_THRU_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id}

SELECT homepage_id, password_yn, loan_time_choice, terms, SUBSTR(reservation_time,0,2) AS reserve_start_hour, SUBSTR(reservation_time,4,2) AS reserve_start_minute, SUBSTR(reservation_time,7,2) AS reserve_end_hour, SUBSTR(reservation_time,10,2) AS reserve_end_minute, SUBSTR(loan_time,0,2) AS loan_start_hour, SUBSTR(loan_time,4,2) AS loan_start_minute, SUBSTR(loan_time,7,2) AS loan_end_hour, SUBSTR(loan_time,10,2) AS loan_end_minute, reservation_time, password_yn, loan_time FROM WALKING_THRU_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO WALKING_THRU_SETTING a USING dual ON (a.homepage_id = #{homepage_id}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET a.password_yn = #{password_yn}, a.reservation_time = #{reserve_start_hour}||':'||#{reserve_start_minute}||'~'||#{reserve_end_hour}||':'||#{reserve_end_minute}, a.loan_time = #{loan_start_hour}||':'||#{loan_start_minute}||'~'||#{loan_end_hour}||':'||#{loan_end_minute}, a.loan_time_choice = #{loan_time_choice}, a.terms = #{terms} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( homepage_id, password_yn, reservation_time, loan_time, loan_time_choice, terms ) VALUES ( #{homepage_id}, #{password_yn}, #{reserve_start_hour}||':'||#{reserve_start_minute}||'~'||#{reserve_end_hour}||':'||#{reserve_end_minute}, #{loan_start_hour}||':'||#{loan_start_minute}||'~'||#{loan_end_hour}||':'||#{loan_end_minute}, #{loan_time_choice}, #{terms} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WALKING_THRU_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24:MI'), 'HH24:MI') BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{reserve_start_hour}||':'||#{reserve_start_minute}, 'HH24:MI') AND TO_DATE(#{reserve_end_hour}||':'||#{reserve_end_minute}, 'HH24:MI')
